answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 7322 Country: United Kingdom Title: Is it permissible to view animate pictures on Internet computer? Question: Assalaamualaykum Q) Is it permissible to view animate pictures on Internet computer? Answer ID: 7322 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 852/852=M/1429) It is unlawful to see the pictures intentionally. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
